verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Both identities are stated, with every constant, sign, exponent and denominator matching: 𝒟_X = X∂_X is `X * deriv`, 𝒟_X𝒜 (φ held fixed, then evaluated at φ = N log X) is `partialX A (phasePoint n X η)`, and the axial denominator N E₀ is `n * E X η`. Two routine rewritings. (i) The paper writes the logarithmic form 1 − 2𝒟_X log E_N; Lean writes 1 − 2X·(d/dX E_N)/E_N, the chain rule for log, legitimate under the hypothesis hE0 : E X η ≠ 0 (and exp > 0, so E_N ≠ 0) — Lean never introduces Real.log of E_N and so needs no positivity, only non-vanishing. (ii) e^{−𝒜/N}(…) appears as (…)/Real.exp (A (phasePoint n X η) / n). The prescriptions of eq-p041-1 enter as the hypotheses hprescribed, in the paper's own forms ∂_φ𝒜 = −(a_L − a₀)/2 and ∂_φℬ = E₀(b_L − b₀)/2 with a₀ = 1 − 2X E₀′/E₀ and b₀ = 2X U₀′/E₀.
